verdict.rationale: A tax agency's online services could plausibly offer user-configured recurring or background automations, such as scheduled payments or automated filings, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents one-off actions: making a payment, filing a return, submitting documents and receiving email notifications. EFILE is a certified-software transmission channel, not a CRA-provided way to set up autonomous recurring automations, so no documented capability exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
